say:4:1720849001:0.text: I never thought you'd actually come.
say:4:1720849001:0.source_cn: 维伦，我从没想过你真的会来。

say:5:1720849002:0.text: When I extended the invitation, you brushed it off so easily. I assumed you wouldn't show.
say:5:1720849002:0.source_cn: 我递给你邀请函时，你毫不犹豫地模糊过去了。我以为你不会来的。

say:6:1720849003:1.text: Still... I'm glad. Thank you for coming.
say:6:1720849003:1.source_cn: 我的意思是……我很开心。谢谢你能过来。

say:8:1720849005:0.text: The one Adrion is holding? I suppose I'll open it properly after the banquet.
say:8:1720849005:0.source_cn: 你是指亚德里恩的手里那份？我恐怕要在舞会后才能仔细拆开看了。

say:9:1720849006:0.text: Though... that hardly matters. Your presence alone is already a gift.
say:9:1720849006:0.source_cn: 这都无所谓。你来了，就是最好的礼物。

say:11:1720849008:0.text: I just remembered... we once made a promise. To share a dance at a ball.
say:11:1720849008:0.source_cn: 我只是忽然想起，过去的确和你有过约定，要在一次舞会上共舞。

say:13:1720849010:0.source_cn: 虽说即将迈入人生的新阶段，但若是在过去留下遗憾，难免也...

say:14:1720849011:0.text: The past is behind us now. We both have to move forward.
say:14:1720849011:0.source_cn: 过去的事都已经过去了，我们都要继续往前走。

say:15:1720849012:0.text: So let this dance be a proper farewell to it.
say:15:1720849012:0.source_cn: 今天这支舞，请将它当做对过去彻底的告别吧。

say:16:1720849013:0.text: Lady Charlotte, may your future be free of the past's shadows.
say:16:1720849013:0.source_cn: 夏洛蒂小姐，愿您的未来，能够不必沾染过去的影子，不受约...

say:17:1720849014:0.text: May you do as you wish, be with who you truly desire, and live the life you truly want.

say:18:1720849015:1.text: Is that your wish as well?

say:23:1720849020:0.text: Hahaha! Forgive me, I couldn't resist.
